*F-NMCOM* (Non-malleable commitment) is part of *Layer 4: Commitments and Proofs* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Crescenzo, Ishai, and Ostrovsky. *Non-interactive and non-malleable commitment*. In 30th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), pages 141–150, 1998.
- Fischlin and Fischlin. *Efficient non-malleable commitment schemes*. In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2000, volume 1880 of LNCS, pages 413–428, 2000.
